name: Auto Trajectory
description: Dash/Spider Orb planning, per-level strategy learning, death diagnostics and Wave Planner.

auto-play.name: Auto Play
auto-play.description: Predictive auto play for cube/robot/ball, ship/UFO/swing/wave and dual mode. Cube and Ball use safe input pulses; Robot and Dash Orbs use validated finite holds. Not available in platformer levels.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draws the predicted path for holding and releasing jump.

trajectory-steps.name: Trajectory Length
trajectory-steps.description: How many physics substeps (240 per second) of the future to draw.

autoplay-lookahead.name: Auto Play Lookahead
autoplay-lookahead.description: How far ahead (physics substeps, 240 per second) the bot plans. Longer values let it set up chains of jumps (e.g. pillar staircases). It still jumps at the last safe moment.

wave-room-aware.name: Wave: Predictive Path Planner
wave-room-aware.description: Wave Planner 2.0: frame-aligned one/two-switch candidate search. Straight paths are tested first; deeper candidates are bounded and opt-in.

straight-fly.name: Straight Fly (Ship / Wave / UFO / Swing)
straight-fly.description: When nothing threatens above or below, hold the current altitude instead of drifting. Costs a few extra short simulations per frame while flying.

show-ui.name: Show Floating Controls
show-ui.description: Shows a draggable, collapsible in-game panel for Auto Play, Trajectory, Wave Planner and route scan status.

level-adaptive-strategy.name: Learn Strategy Per Level
level-adaptive-strategy.description: After Auto Play deaths, compare Ultra Low, Low, Balanced and High planning profiles for this level. The selected profile is saved per level and does not change the device frame-time budget. Learning is based on progress and prediction diagnostics, not guaranteed cause detection.

level-strategy-default.name: First Level Strategy
level-strategy-default.description: Strategy used first for an unlearned level, then used as the fallback when per-level learning is disabled. 0=Ultra Low, 1=Low, 2=Balanced, 3=High.

performance-preset.name: Device Budget
performance-preset.description: Controls the extra CPU-time budget for the device. Per-level planning depth is learned separately.

adaptive-budget.name: Adaptive Budget
adaptive-budget.description: Reduce background prediction work when frame time rises.

jump-protection.name: Jump Protection
jump-protection.description: Temporarily defer visual trajectory refresh after a jump input edge.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes the bot's decisions to the Geode log whenever its action changes (and every few frames near a hazard). Turn on and send the log if the bot misbehaves.

wave-deep-search.name: Wave: Deeper Search
wave-deep-search.description: Enable up to 12 Wave Planner 2.0 candidates with two-switch sequences. Higher CPU cost; keep off on low-end devices.

segment-planner.name: Checkpoint Segment Planner (experimental)
segment-planner.description: Enable checkpoint-aware planning hooks when live segment simulation is connected. Current build includes tested planning primitives; continuous simulation remains active.

global-route-planner.name: Global Route Planner (experimental)
global-route-planner.description: Four-checkpoint beam-search core. Requires live segment simulation results before it can recommend or control a route.
